test_rows.command: set -eu; for binary in build/test_megatruss_station_sanitized build/test_seeded_typology_megablock_sanitized build/test_metabolist_spine_sanitized build/test_interlaced_viaduct_sanitized build/test_rosework_gatehouse_sanitized build/test_interlock_brutalism_sanitized build/test_suspended_arcology_sanitized; do echo "Running sanitized $binary"; ASAN_OPTIONS=${ASAN_OPTIONS:-detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1} UBSAN_OPTIONS=${UBSAN_OPTIONS:-halt_on_error=1} "$binary"; done

set -eu; for binary in build/test_megatruss_station_sanitized build/test_seeded_typology_megablock_sanitized build/test_metabolist_spine_sanitized build/test_interlaced_viaduct_sanitized build/test_rosework_gatehouse_sanitized build/test_interlock_brutalism_sanitized build/test_suspended_arcology_sanitized; do echo "Running sanitized $binary"; ASAN_OPTIONS=${ASAN_OPTIONS:-detect_leaks=1:strict_string_checks=1} UBSAN_OPTIONS=${UBSAN_OPTIONS:-halt_on_error=1} "$binary"; done

limits: One sequential same-worker cold pair; no percentile or population estimate.
Compiler and test unions can overlap; do not sum them as disjoint phases.
RSS is per-child maximum, not simultaneous aggregate memory.
Canonical source-matched required CI and merge admission remain separate.
